verdict.rationale: LlamaParse documents a first-party Split API that automatically segments concatenated PDFs into logical document sections by content category using AI-powered classification. A separate Classify product handles document typing, and Split can be chained with Extract for per-document processing. missing for 10: detail on the per-segment output format and page ranges, a documented single-call packet workflow (Split and Extract are separate chained APIs), and independent or hands-on corroboration of split accuracy.

support.subject: As a data engineer, multi-document packets are classified and split automatically — one upload, per-document results

citations.quote: The Split API provides a simple way to automatically segment concatenated PDFs into logical document sections based on content categories.
Split a PDF containing multiple documents (essays, research papers) into separate segments using AI-powered classification.
Chain them (Split, then Extract) or use one on its own.
Classify lets you automatically categorize documents into types you define (for example: invoice, receipt, contract) using natural-language rules.
